subConfigs.name: CWDTEN[2]
subConfigs.description:
Watchdog Timer Hardware Enable Bit (CONFIG0[31]).
When watchdog timer hardware enable function is enabled, the watchdog enable bit WDTEN (WDT_CTL[7]) and watchdog reset enable bit RSTEN (WDT_CTL[1]) is set to 1 automatically after power on. The clock source of watchdog timer is force at LIRC and LIRC cannot be disabled.
CWDTEN[2:0] is CONFIG0[31][4][3].
011 = WDT hardware enable function is active. WDT clock is always on except chip enters Power-down mode. When chip enter Power-down mode, WDT clock is always on if CWDTDPDEN is 0 or WDT clock is controlled by LIRCEN (CLK_PWRCTL[3]) if CWDTDPDEN is 1. Please refer to bit field description of CWDTDPDEN.
111 = WDT hardware enable function is inactive.
Others = WDT hardware enable function is active. WDT clock is always on.
optionDescription: 0 = Hardware WDT enable function active (depends on CWDTEN[1:0] for full mode)

subConfigs.name: CBORST
subConfigs.description:
Brown-out Reset Enable Bit (CONFIG0[20]).
0 = Brown-out reset Enabled after powered on.
1 = Brown-out reset Disabled after powered on.

subConfigs.name: CBODEN
subConfigs.description:
Brown-out Detector Enable Bit (CONFIG0[19]).
0 = Brown-out detect Enabled after powered on.
1 = Brown-out detect Disabled after powered on.

subConfigs.name: CBS
subConfigs.description:
Chip Booting Selection (CONFIG0[7]).
0 = Direct boot from LDROM through bootloader.
1 = Direct boot from APROM through bootloader.

subConfigs.name: CWDTEN[1:0]
subConfigs.description:
Watchdog Timer Hardware Enable Bits (CONFIG0[4:3]).
When watchdog timer hardware enable function is enabled, the watchdog enable bit WDTEN (WDT_CTL[7]) and watchdog reset enable bit RSTEN (WDT_CTL[1]) is set to 1 automatically after power on. The clock source of watchdog timer is force at LIRC and LIRC cannot be disabled.
011 = WDT hardware enable function is active. WDT clock is always on except chip enters Power-down mode. When chip enter Power-down mode, WDT clock is always on if CWDTDPDEN is 0 or WDT clock is controlled by LIRCEN (CLK_PWRCTL[3]) if CWDTDPDEN is 1.
111 = WDT hardware enable function is inactive.
Others = WDT hardware enable function is active. WDT clock is always on.

subConfigs.name: SPIISPEN
subConfigs.description:
SPI ISP Mode Enable Bit (CONFIG3[12]).
0 = Disabled.
1 = Enabled.

subConfigs.name: I2CISPEN
subConfigs.description:
I2C ISP Mode Enable Bit (CONFIG3[11]).
0 = Disabled.
1 = Enabled.

subConfigs.name: CANISPEN
subConfigs.description:
CAN ISP Mode Enable Bit (CONFIG3[10]).
0 = Disabled.
1 = Enabled.

subConfigs.name: USBISPDIS
subConfigs.description:
USB ISP Mode Disable Bit (CONFIG3[9]).
0 = USB ISP mode Enabled.
1 = USB ISP mode Disabled.

subConfigs.name: UARTISPEN
subConfigs.description:
UART ISP Mode Enable Bit (CONFIG3[8]).
0 = UART ISP mode Disabled.
1 = UART ISP mode Enabled.
